subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2563793cb8bd45c8c62939409e1ac074323025b78ccd4fed92b238289861b59.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Upper side arrow is moving 45º clockwise direction in next figure.

2) Lower side arrow is moving 45º anticlockwise direction in next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d756248aec2b51a5b72ee15905ff7c6ae95df880525d1b599c0bd70afb0b9809.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
